verdict.rationale: Gram's docs describe building an MCP server with external OAuth authentication, using any OAuth 2.0 provider you run (Auth0, Okta, Keycloak, or your own server). That covers bringing your own OAuth provider and credentials. Nothing in the evidence shows custom branding or white-labeling of the consent or authorization screens. Missing for 10: branded or white-labeled authorization UI, explicit docs on supplying your own OAuth client ID and secret for the hosted flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
